_doc: Level H proportions, G96 strand 2026-10-27: rig G re-solved so the rig rendered at rest through the GAME cameras (ortho, 30 deg elevation) at 96 px (2x of the 96 cell -> 128 cell) matches the 96 px auto masters v2/pixelize/top1/EC0_<V>_96 (centred-bow set, 13:10) by the section method of v2/g96/scripts/meas96.py (cal.py sections adapted: crown excl. bow+knot, eye, chin, shoulder, armpit, waist(obi), hem, sock top, knee, ankle, sole + widths). Multipliers relative to v2/hy3d/partsAB4f + RIGCAL keys (repro_g.py) + G96 keys (v2/g96/scripts/repro_h.py): legs.sock (thigh-high sock ID band, sock matid sRGB ~(38,42,71)), arms.flare/flarez/flare0 (kimono sleeve bell), skirt.flarez, bow/bun dy/dz + forced x-centring (knot+bow on the midline, back-top). Bone names + elbow split (rig_lib ELBOW=1) unchanged. Apply: .scratch/hunyuan/venv/bin/python -I v2/g96/scripts/repro_h.py PROPORTIONS_H.json v2/hy3d/partsAB4f v2/hy3d/best/skel.txt OUT. Camera scale: PPU 26.304 px/unit at the 96 cell (= 52.608 at the 192 cell used for s96 guides); render with SOCKS=1 (knee ball takes the sock colour).
